newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Caltex Philippines raises market share to 24.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Philippines raises market share to 24.4 pct.

text.p: Caltex (Philippines) Inc has posted an increase in market share to 24.4 percent for the first quarter of 1997 from the previous year's 23.6 percent while the shares of its two rivals dropped.
An industry report on total oil inland trade data released on Thursday showed Petron Corp's market share had slipped to 41.9 percent from 42.6 percent in the first quarter last year.
The market share of Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp declined slightly to 33.3 percent from 33.9 percent.
Caltex Philippines is a subsidiary of Caltex Petroleum Corp, a joint venture between Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp. Pilipinas Shell is a unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell group of companies.
The Philippine oil industry was fully deregulated in February this year.
